businessScenario: 共性层通用业务-计算每日各币种对本币及美元的折算汇率

fdmScriptsAnalyzed.transformLogic: 从核心系统TDM表T_CRBS_PZSHL取数，对币种代码huobdh通过F_CO_TRANS_CD(CRBS0067)进行码值标准化后得到currcy_cd，其他字段直接映射并进行有变更流水处理（F2方式）

knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode:
INSERT INTO CDM.C_COM_EXCH_RATE (data_dt, currcy_cd, dom_currcy_convt_price, usd_convt_price)
SELECT DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}', currcy_cd,
  CASE WHEN currcy_cd='156' THEN 1 ELSE SUM(dom_currcy_convt_price) END AS dom_currcy_convt_price,
  SUM(usd_convt_price) AS usd_convt_price
FROM (
  SELECT currcy_cd, dom_currcy_convt_price, usd_convt_price
  FROM FDM.F_CO_CRBS_CONVT_EXCH_RATE_PARAM
  WHERE convt_category_cd='1' AND record_sts_cd='0'
    AND eff_dt IN (
      SELECT eff_dt FROM FDM.F_CO_CRBS_CONVT_EXCH_RATE_PARAM
      WHERE convt_category_cd='1' AND record_sts_cd='0' AND eff_dt<='{ETL_TX_DT}'
      ORDER BY eff_dt DESC LIMIT 1
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT currcy_cd, dom_currcy_convt_price, usd_convt_price
  FROM FDM.F_CO_CRBS_CONVT_EXCH_RATE_PARAM
  WHERE convt_category_cd='0' AND record_sts_cd='0'
    AND eff_dt IN (
      SELECT eff_dt FROM FDM.F_CO_CRBS_CONVT_EXCH_RATE_PARAM
      WHERE convt_category_cd='0' AND record_sts_cd='0' AND eff_dt<='{ETL_TX_DT}'
      ORDER BY eff_dt DESC LIMIT 1
    )
) T
GROUP BY currcy_cd
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode:
INSERT INTO CDM.C_COM_EXCH_RATE (data_dt, currcy_cd, dom_currcy_convt_price, usd_convt_price)
SELECT DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}',
  CASE WHEN huobdh='156' THEN '156' ELSE COALESCE(T2.stand_cd_val,'@'||COALESCE(huobdh,'')) END AS currcy_cd,
  CASE WHEN huobdh='156' THEN 1 ELSE SUM(BBIZSJ) END AS dom_currcy_convt_price,
  SUM(MEYZSJ) AS usd_convt_price
FROM ODM.O_CRBS_PZSHL T1
LEFT JOIN FDM.F_CO_TRANS_CD T2 ON T1.huobdh=T2.src_cd_val AND T2.stand_cd_tab_no='CRBS0067'
WHERE CVTKND='1' AND JILUZT='0'
  AND SXIORQ IN (
    SELECT SXIORQ FROM ODM.O_CRBS_PZSHL WHERE CVTKND='1' AND JILUZT='0' AND SXIORQ<='{ETL_TX_DT}'
    ORDER BY SXIORQ DESC LIMIT 1
  )
UNION ALL
SELECT currcy_cd, dom_currcy_convt_price, usd_convt_price
FROM ODM.O_CRBS_PZSHL
WHERE CVTKND='0' AND JILUZT='0'
  AND SXIORQ IN (
    SELECT SXIORQ FROM ODM.O_CRBS_PZSHL WHERE CVTKND='0' AND JILUZT='0' AND SXIORQ<='{ETL_TX_DT}'
    ORDER BY SXIORQ DESC LIMIT 1
  )
GROUP BY currcy_cd
knowledgeBlocks.businessScenario: 核心系统汇率管理-每日获取各币种最新有效的人民币折算价和美元折算价
knowledgeBlocks.tableJoinLogic: 通过对F_CO_CRBS_CONVT_EXCH_RATE_PARAM两次子查询（UNION ALL），分别取折算种类=1（折美元）和折算种类=0（折人民币）的最新生效日期数据，然后按币种汇总

fieldMappings.description: 币种代码（经过CRBS0067码值标准化）

traceChains.filterConditions: record_sts_cd='0'（正常记录），按折算种类分别取最新生效日期

derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 筛选人行中间价折算种类（折算为人民币）的有效汇率记录

derivedKnowledge.knowledgeName: 最新有效汇率获取方法
derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT eff_dt FROM F_CO_CRBS_CONVT_EXCH_RATE_PARAM WHERE record_sts_cd='0' AND eff_dt<='{日期}' ORDER BY eff_dt DESC LIMIT 1
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 通过生效日期倒序取最新一条记录的方式获取当前有效日期，适用于拉链/有效期管理的表

derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 人民币（币种代码156）对本币的折算价固定为1，其他币种取实际折算价

keyBusinessRules.ruleName: 折算汇率取最新生效日期规则
keyBusinessRules.condition: eff_dt<='{ETL_TX_DT}' ORDER BY eff_dt DESC LIMIT 1
keyBusinessRules.description: 每天取不晚于数据日期的最新生效日期对应的汇率，确保使用当前有效的汇率数据

keyBusinessRules.condition: convt_category_cd='1'（外管折算价/折美元）convt_category_cd='0'（人行中间价/折人民币）
keyBusinessRules.description: 按折算种类分别取两种汇率，UNION ALL后按币种汇总，使每个币种同时拥有本币和美元两种折算价

keyBusinessRules.ruleName: 人民币固定折算价规则
keyBusinessRules.description: 人民币（币种代码156）对本币的折算价固定为1，不需要从源表取数
只取正常状态的记录（0=正常，1=删除，R=冲正）
